changes.context_outcome_repair: welp-context 0.3.0-draft (Granite D-01, METHODOLOGY_DEFECT repaired prospectively): an execution-valid Controlled Context cell that exhausts its generation budget and emits no visible answer is a measured BUDGET_LIMITED row with the CP-1 triple semantic NOT_EVALUABLE / completion FAIL_LENGTH / budget EXHAUSTED_IN_REASONING under a declared/effective-ON reasoning surface (UNKNOWN when attribution is unsupported). It covers required-cell coverage and never validates capability: a budget-limited practical rung stays PARTIAL, useful_context_max and practical_rung_validated still require trusted VALIDATED cells. The evidence bundle accepts an answerless measured row only when the raw record proves the terminal generation state and the evidence binds the empty-answer sha256; invalid empty-answer records fail closed (B_context_missing_raw). The 0.2.0 contract and all historical rows stay frozen and valid for reproduction.
changes.cp1_alignment: The context module's outcome triples are CP-1-consistent on every path (Granite M-1): an empty final-answer channel is never semantic FAIL — the empty-answer gate bag can no longer manufacture decoy-asserted FAIL evidence; reasoning consumption itself is a deployment/budget limitation, never a semantic failure, unsafe behavior or missing coverage.
changes.m2_selftest_interpreter: Harness/validator subprocess selftest oracles resolve a real interpreter via resolve_selftest_interpreter (WELP_SELFTEST_PYTHON override, sys.executable, PATH python3/python; each candidate must execute a trivial isolated CPython 3 program), so agent/AppImage wrapper environments can no longer report phantom fixture failures (Granite M-2); a wrapper-style sys.executable regression test and a clear no-interpreter failure were added.
changes.synthetic_integration: New synthetic variant context-budget-limited: a complete campaign with one valid answerless BUDGET_LIMITED cell and all other required evidence valid stays structurally valid, coverage complete, capability PARTIAL, execution COMPLETE_PASS with a freshly derived classification; mutated evidence proves invalid empty-answer records fail closed.
changes.source_attribution: welp-outcomes re-exports the frozen reasoning-state vocabularies; classification 0.4.0, validator R-rules and report rendering consume the repaired summary unchanged.
changes.compatibility: Older snapshots, retained campaign evidence, frozen manifests and historical reports stay immutable. Frozen 0.1.0/0.2.0 context contracts remain valid for reproduction; the retained Granite COMPLETE_WITH_GAPS predecessor event and its bundle stay byte-identical; its linked successor re-derives the affected cell from original raw bytes under this snapshot.

limitations: DRAFT policy thresholds are not population-level guarantees.

EXHAUSTED_IN_REASONING attribution from a declared/effective-ON surface without retained reasoning bytes is a derivation from measured token accounting (empty answer lane, positive completion tokens) plus the verified reasoning surface, never a fabricated token split; undeclared surfaces stay UNKNOWN.
A trusted BUDGET_LIMITED cell proves coverage, not capability; profile-level budget guidance for reasoning-heavy models must come from the recorded completion/budget axes.
Synthetic integration fixtures are not model measurements.

The retained Granite predecessor's runs/assemble-findings.json referenced by its report was not present on disk at repair time; the D-01 structural error was re-derived from the retained raw cell bytes against the frozen 0.2.0 harness instead.
